system.description:
Informative Scroll (Passive): When you purchase an Informative Scroll, choose one Knowledge Talent you possess. Provided this scroll is equipped in a RIS slot, you gain +1 to all Knowledge Talents made with this Talent. The effects of Informative Scrolls do not stack. (On the sheet: name it after the Talent, e.g. “Informative Scroll (History)”.)

1 Item Slot (RIS Passive) · 100gc · Baubles, rulebook p.207
